services.name: Programs & Happenings
services.desc: Adult - $15 Senior [62+] - $10 Teacher, Student, or Youth [6-17] - $8 BMI Members - Always Free! BMI proudly offers free admission to active duty and retired military personnel, with military ID, and to Museums for All visitors. There are many ways you can show your support for the Baltimore Museum of Industry. Interested in donating an artifact to the collection, please visit our Artifact Donation

services.name: Field Trips
services.desc: Arrangements for student groups must be made in advance. Teachers/staff are free and the parent chaperone entry fee is $10.00. Remember to schedule a break for a bagged lunch! Choose from an exciting selection of educational activities that are grade-specific and rich in content with specific and meaningful learning outcomes. Most programs can be booked as an in-class experience delivered at your school by our staff. “We had an amazing time! Students were completely focused and engaged. The staff’s knowledge and management was spectacular. The timing of all parts of our trip was perfect. Everyone had a great time - students, chaperones and teachers. Can’t wait to return! Thank you!” - Wendy

services.name: After School Special
services.desc: At the Baltimore Museum of Industry, we spend all day with your children and students; now we want to spend an evening with you! Call up the babysitter and put on your comfortable shoes. After School Special, presented by Tate Engineering, invites parents, educators, neighbors, and friends alike to experience the Baltimore Museum of Industry, the big-kid way. Join us on Thursday, September 24 from 6:30 to 9 p.m. as we activate the entire museum with tours, activities, and crafts scaled up for the big kid in all of us. Grab your first drink on us and enjoy our cash bar and light bites. Experience our working Cannery exhibit, craft rockets and roller coasters, or take a tour and stroll
